data.one_liner: Text widget that adds word break support for CJK sentences.
data.what_it_does: It wraps a Text widget and inserts line breaks at word boundaries for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text. The widget can be used as a drop‑in replacement for Text when CJK word breaking is required.
use_when: Need to display CJK text that should wrap on word boundaries
Target small screens where default Text wrapping is insufficient
You want a lightweight, const‑constructible widget with no external dependencies
avoid_when: Using only English or other languages that already wrap correctly
Flutter later adds native CJK word break support
You need advanced text styling beyond what Text offers
strengths: Simple API, drop‑in replacement for Text
weaknesses: No support for other languages or advanced text features
